name: tennis-exploration-followup-v1
motivation: The completed baseline campaign had sparse positive training episodes and poor held-out returns.
checkpoint_selection: maximum validation mean, first tie; validation seeds are development inputs already seen in baseline campaign
final_comparison: exploration-selected policy, frozen baseline-selected policy, random and zero; same fresh test environment seed per training-seed group
limits: This exploratory protocol was chosen after inspecting baseline results. Its 950000-offset test seed family is new and frozen before exploration training. The comparison is descriptive over three paired training seeds, not a general algorithm-superiority claim. Both protocols receive 1000 training episodes, but their step counts and compute can differ. No hyperparameters are changed in response to these new final scores.
